newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Offshore buying buoys S.African bonds, rand steady.
newsitem.headline: Offshore buying buoys S.African bonds, rand steady.

text.p: 1240 GMT - Good offshore demand pushes South African long bonds yields lower through 14.80 level in thin early afternoon trade with some local institutional interest at higher levels in longer-dated R153 stock.
* Key R150 bond more than 10 basis points stronger at 14.735 percent from 14.845 percent overnight and a morning high of 14.87 percent.
* Dealers say morning moves fairly positive but not convincing break with July 1 forex easing uncertainty still overriding factor.
* Some say test of 14.91 to 15 pct still on the cards in short-term.
* Mkt still long on stock and players expected to offload.
* Rand hovers after recovering from morning losses. Last at 4.5145/5175 vs dollar from 4.5125/5155 late on Wednesday and morning weakest bid of 4.5175.
* Some forex traders say rand mkt starting to get long dollars and run weaker losing some momentum.
* No great shakes seen for rest of session.
